## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] PAM3 signaling achieves a 50% data rate improvement over binary NRZ at identical Nyquist frequencies by encoding three voltage levels into two transmitted unit intervals. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: PAM3 Modulation and GDDR7 Channel Interleaving · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad

## Facts and statements

- [statement] GDDR7 splits each physical device channel into dual independent 16-bit sub-channels, enabling concurrent burst accesses that avoid bank collision stalls during attention matrix reads. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: PAM3 Modulation and GDDR7 Channel Interleaving · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
